title: Kacie Kintz:
headline: Adopt-A-Block served about 500 people a month last year. In September it served over 2,500. The director explains how the line grew five times, and why the Dream Center meets every family with love and no shame.
story: Kacie Kintz runs the Dream Center Dallas. On the 10 Oct Adopt-A-Block she walked the lot with Kalindi and gave the numbers: 500 a month last year, 2,500 last month, 1,400 people in two hours on a Thursday food route, a whole street closed for the line, families who camp out the night before. This cut is the first one from the day and the client's style test. Series: Outrageous Generosity.

Loops: L1 “How did it grow five times?” opens 0:00 and closes at 0:06 with the 1,400 line. L2 “Why do they keep going?” opens 0:00 and closes in the button. Stakes: the line is five times longer than a year ago; if the Dream Center stops, 2,500 families a month have nowhere to go.
do: Open on Kacie's face, already talking, with the hook text.

Cut to the car line and the trunk loading under the numbers.
Let “break the cycle” land last. Hold one second on her.
Use only the files named here.
